data.long_meaning: Haizar is derived from the Arabic word 'haaza', meaning 'to reward' or 'to give'. This name is a reminder of Allah's blessings and generosity towards His creation. Parents who choose Haizar usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
